title: Projectile
text: Put an Air Microcore in the shape slot. Crosshair-Projectile flies straight along your view; Target-Projectile homes toward a selected creature or block. Contact triggers the carried effects.

Self-Projectile carries the caster in flight; Ground-Projectile launches spell blocks resembling the selected surfaces upward. Ordinary projectiles are unaffected by water currents and can be reflected.
